title: Developing microfluidic purification techniques for biodiesel production from recycled grease trap waste
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2024, 8,5806-5817
DOI: 10.1039/D4SE00567H, Paper
Thanh K. N. Pham, Trang T. Nguyen, Nguyen Van Duc Long, Nam Nghiep Tran, Muhammad Yousaf Arshad, Mohammad Mohsen Sarafraz, Volker Hessel
This study aimed to investigate the desulphurisation of model biodiesel with thiophene using three solvents: sulfolane, ionic liquids ([BMIM]AlCl4, [BMIM]MSA), and deep eutectic solvents (choline chloride : phenol, ChCl : polyethylene glycol).
